job.job_description:
Passing Year: 2024 MCA / MBA / MSc (Computer Science, IT)

Key Responsibilities
Assist in designing, developing, and deploying machine learning models.
Work with data processing, cleaning, and feature engineering tasks.
Develop Python scripts and automation tools to support AI workflows.
Collaborate with senior AI/ML engineers on model training, evaluation, and optimization.
Document code, model workflows, and project findings.
Stay updated with the latest AI/ML trends and techniques.
Required Skills
Strong foundation in Python programming.
Basic understanding of Machine Learning algorithms and concepts.
Hands-on familiarity with ML libraries: NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn.
Knowledge of deep learning (TensorFlow, PyTorch) is a plus.
Good analytical, mathematical, and problem-solving skills.
Passion for AI/ML and willingness to learn continuously.
